messages:
maria: Heads up — we started getting a spike of remote_write 504s to cortex in us-west2 around 09:12 UTC. p95 write latency jumped to ~5.8s and prometheus remote_write queue length climbed to ~120k. @kevin can you look?
kevin: seeing it. grafana panel 'cortex_ingest_series_rate' shows a sudden series_count bump from metrics scraped by gpu-exporter on the gpu-preempt nodepool. cardinality up ~8x starting at 09:10.
ash: any idea what label exploded? can we find the series pattern?
maria: quick promql I ran: `count by(__name__, instance, gpu_id) (gpu_temp_celsius)` — there are thousands of unique `gpu_id` values that weren't there before.
kevin: logs from the daemonset show exporter started including `gpu_serial` label after a kernel/runtime update on the node image. looks like a vendor driver change exposes per-card serials and exporter picks it up as a label.
maria: ugh. easy fix: drop the label in the scrape relabel_config. proposed relabel:
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["gpu_serial"]
    action: drop
```
can someone push that to the affected prometheus (us-west2 gpu-scrapes) as a hotfix?
ash: agree. also temp mitigation: lower scrape frequency / aggregate. suggest change scrape_interval: 30s -> 60s and add relabel_keep to only host metrics.
kevin: I'll patch the prometheus-operator scrapeconfig for the `gpu-exporter` serviceMonitor in us-west2 and scale the scrape interval. Pushing as a canary to two prometheus replicas first.
deploy-bot: rolled out prometheus scrapeconfig patch to prometheus-usw2-canary (replica-2). watch for remote_write errors.
sre-bot: alertmanager: silenced `RemoteWriteErrorsHigh` for prometheus-usw2 for 1h (reason: emergency mitigation).
ash: quick k8s patch we applied to daemonset to stop adding label in exporter env: `- name: GPU_LABEL_FILTER\n  value: \"exclude=gpu_serial\"` — vendor still debugging upstream.
maria: thanks. billing note: ingest into cortex increased token/series usage, cost +~3% in last hour. opening a ticket to track cost delta and rollback window.
kevin: after canary looks good (10m), will roll to remaining prometheus replicas and remove the temporary scrape_interval change but keep drop relabel for 24h just in case.
maria: filing follow-up: PR 432 in infra-exporters repo removes gpu_serial emission from exporter. link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-exporters/pull/432
ash: once PR is live we'll patch daemonset image and remove the relabel drop (but keep monitoring dashboards). also create a dashboard panel showing unique label cardinality per label so this doesn't blindside us again.
maria: summary: immediate actions: 1) canary prometheus relabel patch (kevin) 2) silence noisy alert (sre-bot) 3) daemonset env patch to stop emitting (ash) 4) PR merged (maria). I'll follow up with a postmortem with timeline and cost impact.
kevin: monitoring the remote_write queue now — it's trending down. p95 write latency back to ~320ms. will update in 5.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: updating thread — canary rollout successful, no new 504s after full roll. closing emergency. recommend follow-up ticket to add cardinality guards in alerting and a runbook entry.
